properties.displayName: SCF - Manual attestation for Key Vault Security and Compliance Control
properties.description: This policy requires manual attestation to confirm that all encryption keys are encrypted and stored in a secure, protected key vault. Encryption keys may be managed in a cloud platform–provided multi-tenant key management service or key vault. The key vault service must be validated to Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) 140-2 Level 2.
